items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: I work with some parades with Andrew Morgan, and with Andrew Jefferson.

ctx.x: See when Pajot died, he was the one who played with us. See when Pajot died. I remember that. I was there.
And I work with some parades with Andrew Morgan, and with Andrew Jefferson. And, oh, in fact, I've played quite a few parades.
That's in late years, or early years?
